meta.range: 2026-09-19 00:00 to 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC (data exists from 2026-09-19 10:52 UTC; PostHog was installed that day)
meta.human_filter: sessions with >=1 $pageview, no event with $virt_is_bot = true, entry referrer not localhost:3456 / 127.0.0.1:3456 / *.vercel.app (unless a query says otherwise)
meta.caveat: Test-account cohort 580233 has 0 members, so team traffic is included (about 48 sessions from 4 devices with 10+ sessions each, Q24). Aggregates only.

queries.what: Landing pages by host (human, non-internal sessions)
queries.hogql: SELECT entry_host, entry_path, count() AS sessions, countIf(paid = 1) AS paid_sessions, round(100*countIf(pvs = 1)/count(),1) AS pct_one_page, round(quantile(0.5)(dur),0) AS median_dur_s, countIf(store_pv > 0) AS reached_store, countIf(form_started > 0) AS form_started, countIf(purchased > 0) AS purchases FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, any(session.$entry_hostname) AS entry_host, any(session.$entry_pathname) AS entry_path, any(session.$session_duration) AS dur, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, if(coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_medium),'') = 'paid' OR (coalesce(any(session.$entry_fbclid),'') != '' AND coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_source),'') = ''), 1, 0) AS paid, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname NOT LIKE '/thanks%') AS store_pv, countIf(event = 'preorder_form_started') AS form_started, countIf(event = 'purchase') AS purchased, countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pvs FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$pageview','preorder_form_started','purchase') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING pvs > 0 AND is_bot = 0 AND NOT (coalesce(ref,'') IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR coalesce(ref,'') LIKE '%vercel.app') ) GROUP BY entry_host, entry_path ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 40

queries.what: Autocaptured clicks that carry the cta attribute, by page and device (all sessions)
queries.hogql: SELECT properties.$host AS host, properties.$pathname AS path, coalesce(properties.cta,'') AS cta, properties.$device_type AS device, count() AS clicks, uniq(properties.$session_id) AS sessions FROM events WHERE event = '$autocapture' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND properties.$event_type = 'click' AND coalesce(properties.cta,'') != '' GROUP BY host, path, cta, device ORDER BY clicks DESC LIMIT 50

queries.what: All clicks on a link to store.kheelona.com from kheelona.com, split by whether the cta attribute was present
queries.hogql: SELECT properties.$device_type AS device, if(coalesce(properties.cta,'') = '', '(no cta attribute)', properties.cta) AS cta, count() AS clicks, uniq(properties.$session_id) AS sessions FROM events WHERE event = '$autocapture' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND elements_chain_href LIKE '%store.kheelona.com%' GROUP BY ROLLUP(device, cta) ORDER BY device, clicks DESC

queries.what: Where the untagged store-link clicks sit (container classes in the element chain)
queries.hogql: SELECT properties.$device_type AS device, properties.$pathname AS path, position(elements_chain, 'md:hidden') > 0 AS in_md_hidden_bar, position(elements_chain, 'fixed') > 0 AS in_fixed_container, position(elements_chain, 'text-[14px]') > 0 AS small_pill, count() AS clicks FROM events WHERE event = '$autocapture' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND elements_chain_href LIKE '%store.kheelona.com%' AND coalesce(properties.cta,'') = '' GROUP BY device, path, in_md_hidden_bar, in_fixed_container, small_pill ORDER BY clicks DESC
queries.code_reference: The md:hidden fixed bottom bar is the mobile dock of the Kheelu guide; its pre-order <a> has no data-ph-capture-attribute-cta (git show archive/pre-reset-2026-10-10:src/components/organisms/KheeluGuide.tsx, lines 255-279).

queries.what: Store reach for sessions that saw the product page vs Home only; WhatsApp link clicks; PlayOS views
queries.hogql: SELECT device, countIf(product_pv > 0) AS saw_product_page, countIf(product_pv > 0 AND store_pv > 0) AS saw_product_and_store, countIf(product_pv = 0 AND home_pv > 0) AS home_no_product, countIf(product_pv = 0 AND home_pv > 0 AND store_pv > 0) AS home_no_product_and_store, countIf(wa_clicks > 0) AS sessions_with_whatsapp_click, sum(wa_clicks) AS whatsapp_clicks, countIf(playos_pv > 0) AS saw_playos FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/products/kheelu%') AS product_pv, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname = '/') AS home_pv, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$pathname = '/playos') AS playos_pv, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname NOT LIKE '/thanks%') AS store_pv, countIf(event = '$autocapture' AND (elements_chain_href LIKE '%wa.me%' OR elements_chain_href LIKE '%whatsapp%')) AS wa_clicks, countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pvs FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$pageview','$autocapture') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING pvs > 0 AND is_bot = 0 AND NOT (coalesce(ref,'') IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR coalesce(ref,'') LIKE '%vercel.app') ) WHERE device IN ('Mobile','Desktop') GROUP BY ROLLUP(device)

queries.what: Not-paid sessions: store reach with and without a customer-video play (aria-label starting 'Play: ')
queries.hogql: SELECT device, played_video, count() AS sessions, countIf(store_pv > 0) AS reached_store, round(100*countIf(store_pv > 0)/count(), 1) AS pct_reached_store, countIf(form_started > 0) AS form_started, countIf(purchased > 0) AS purchased FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, if(countIf(event = '$autocapture' AND match(elements_chain, 'aria-label="Play: ')) > 0, 'played a video', 'no video play') AS played_video, if(coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_medium),'') = 'paid' OR (coalesce(any(session.$entry_fbclid),'') != '' AND coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_source),'') = ''), 1, 0) AS paid, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot, countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pvs, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname NOT LIKE '/thanks%') AS store_pv, countIf(event = 'preorder_form_started') AS form_started, countIf(event = 'purchase') AS purchased FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$pageview','$autocapture','preorder_form_started','purchase') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING pvs > 0 AND is_bot = 0 AND paid = 0 AND NOT (coalesce(ref,'') IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR coalesce(ref,'') LIKE '%vercel.app') ) WHERE device IN ('Mobile','Desktop') GROUP BY device, played_video ORDER BY device, played_video
